name: Oojima Yuuki
source:
Yuuki is the protagonist of Koi to Senkyo to Chocolate and is a second year male student at the Takafuji Academy, who lives in an apartment with his mother. He is a member of Shokken.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Koi_to_Senkyo_to_Chocolate]Wikipedia[/url].]
